test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How much will a sum of Rs. 16,000 become after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 20% per annum compound interest?
solution:
Given:

Sum = Rs. 16000

Time = 1 year

Rate = 20%

Concept used:

When the sum is compounded half-yearly, then the rate of interest becomes half and time becomes double.

Formula used:

A = P (1 + R/100)T

C.I = A - P

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, T = Time, C.I = Compound interest and R = rate of interest

Calculation:

For compounded half yearly,

R = 20%/2 = 10%

T = 2 × 1 = 2 years

According to the question,

A = P (1 + R/100)T

⇒ 16000(1 + 10/100)2

⇒ 16000(1 + 1/10)2

⇒ 16000(11/10)2

⇒ 16000(121/100)

⇒ 160 × 121 = 19360

∴ The amount is Rs. 19360.
